title: RosTopics
description: ROS2 topic names used by the robot and telemetry. Rationale for the values is in other/docs/adr.

system_status.description: System diagnostics, also used by telemetry_bridge_node.

navigation.description: Topics published by the navigation stack.

odometry.description: Odometry from track_navigator_node. As of 2026-08-02 no node publishes it; the telemetry bridge subscribes but receives no data.

laps_completed.description: Lap count from track_navigator_node's CoreNavigator/LapDetector, the only thing that detects a lap crossing.

current_corridor.description: Active track corridor (Section name: north/south/east/west), BEST_EFFORT, published every control tick.

scan.description: LIDAR range data from the Slamtec C1.

vision_detections.description: Vision detections (std_msgs/String), as JSON, published by vision_node.

ackermann_cmd.description: Ackermann drive command to the drive and steering nodes.

joint_states.description: Joint state feedback: steering angle, drive speed, encoder position.

steering_position.description: Current steering position in degrees, published by ackermann_motor_node.

drive_speed.description: Current drive speed in degrees/s, published by ackermann_motor_node.

status.description: Motor status diagnostics, published by ackermann_motor_node.

jumper_inserted.description: Challenge-mode jumper state, published by the Pi Zero.

event.description: Button events from button_node on the Pi Zero.

hold.description: JSON hold-progress feedback from button_node, for the OLED countdown.

telemetry_summary.description: Low-rate lidar/yaw/detection summary for the OLED, from telemetry_bridge_node.

oled_mirror.description: Live mirror of the OLED panel, published by oled_display_node.

run_path.description: Latched run directory the recorder just started writing to, so a separate process can write into the same mcap directory.

simulation.description: Simulation-only topics, published by the live visualizer.

track.description: Simulated track markers. Cached and re-sent about once a second.

plan.description: Planned polyline the navigator is tracking right now, as JSON. A belief, not ground truth.

sign_estimates.description: Sign estimates the plan was built from, as JSON.

robot_model.description: Chassis/sensor/wheel geometry in the base_link frame, split off the track topic so the per-tick wheels are not wiped by the marker array's DELETEALL.
